scope.detail: Six files, every one inside the pinned lock, plus this lane's own manifest, .ops/sync file and proof bundle. No new test file, so no root package.json wiring. No workflow, no merge control, no branch protection, no containment setting, no deploy path and no migration is touched.

limits: The runtime_proof receipt establishes that the EXISTING T1 live-proof suites still pass at this anchor against staging. It does NOT exercise this lane's own change against a live database - no t1-proof suite for the fallback waiver exists yet. Writing one requires adding apps/api/src/t1-proof-utv2-1842-*.test.ts AND wiring it into the root package.json test:t1-proof:live script, and package.json is outside this lane's pinned file_scope_lock, which an agent cannot widen. That is why the non-required 'Require live-DB proof for runtime changes' check is red on this PR, and it is a real finding rather than a defective check. It needs a CODEOWNERS scope-override/v1 for package.json, or the skip-proof-coverage label.

The change is control-flow only and touches no database access path: the waiver decides whether checkEventExistenceGate is called, and that gate's own behaviour is unmodified. The behavioural evidence here is therefore in-process against the in-memory repository bundle, which is the same harness the pre-existing event-gate tests use.

This lane does not prove Milestone 1 step 4 end to end. It removes the API-side refusal that blocked it. Reaching the deployed form, authenticating, and submitting a real pick remain a separate run against the deployed system.

The non-required 'Shadow Parity Check' is red because no mechanically read-only production credential is provisioned; it refuses service-role credentials by design, so it compared nothing and reached no parity conclusion. Provisioning that credential is a reserved secrets decision.
